drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:start-from-the-persons-own-work row: input_schema and steps search and gather with their submit shapes); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:start-from-the-persons-own-work for this request: plan my autumn bakery menu, starting from my own notes and principles."
no_lists_because: The workflow searches the places the person already keeps their own work in and writes new learnings back where the next AI reads first; it names no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Say the plan, design or advice you want, in your words, as request (came_from is optional).

2. Say "Run workflow:start-from-the-persons-own-work". Step search looks in your files, notes, recordings, your AIs' past conversations, your pursuits and any framework rows, and says what it searched and what came back in each place, including nothing.

3. Step gather lists each framework or principle you yourself put in words, quoted exactly with where it is kept; it adds none you did not write or say. Step apply says whether each fits and what it changes.
4. Step answer gives the plan, design or advice citing your own words and where each is kept, and writes anything new it learned about your thinking back where the next AI reads first.
